n38e6bd0086.headline: Latest study on wealth inequality: only 26 people essentially control the world
n38e6bd0086.summary: A study by Oxfam reveals that 26 billionaires control wealth equivalent to that of the poorest 3.8 billion people worldwide.
n38e6bd0086.why: Wealth inequality has implications for economic policy, social stability, and investment trends globally.

nb42bca23cd.headline: Pharmaceutical company Takeda acquired Shire and aims to expand investment in the country
nb42bca23cd.summary: Japanese pharmaceutical company Takeda acquired British firm Shire for $62 billion and plans to increase investment in Argentina, viewing it as a key growth opportunity despite the country's economic crisis.
nb42bca23cd.why: Takeda is a major global pharmaceutical company, and its acquisition of Shire is one of the largest in the sector. Expansion plans in Argentina highlight strategic growth in emerging markets amid challenging economic conditions.

impacts.name: Takeda
impacts.why: Takeda's acquisition expands its global footprint and growth prospects.
